thread:
Nora Ahmed: dogfooding the Unit Econ dashboard now — think there’s a bug / weird behavior w/ the Customer Tier filter.

When I set Tier = "Self-serve" the top KPI ($/1M output tokens) changes, but the Top Models table still includes models that are basically Dedicated-only (at least from what I remember). Also the legend still says "All tiers" in a couple spots even though the filter pill shows "Self-serve".

Anyone else seeing this?

Felix Schneider: :eyes: can you share screenshot + exact filter state? (time range / model / region / tier) 

Also are you clicking the pill dropdown or using a saved view?

Nora Ahmed: no saved view. 
Time: Last 7d
Model: All
Region: All
Tier: Self-serve
Then drilldown into Top Models and sort by $/1M — still seeing `llama-70b-dedicated-*` variants.

Chloe Martin: that smells like the table query ignoring tier filter while KPI timeseries respects it. We split endpoints there.

Do you also see it if you hard refresh (no cached response)?

Nora Ahmed: hard refresh didn’t change.

Allison Grant: fwiw I saw something similar yesterday but assumed it was "Unknown" tier getting bucketed weirdly. Might be that the table is including Unknown even when filtered?

Mei Lin: quick note on data side: tier derivation can be `unknown` for some older rows (esp during backfill windows). If UI filter is implemented as `tier IN (...)` but KPI query does `COALESCE(tier,'self_serve')` (or vice versa) you can get inconsistent views.

Felix Schneider: checking prod logs now.

Do you see an "Unknown" option in tier dropdown? (I think we hid it per design)

Nora Ahmed: I don’t see "Unknown" in the dropdown.

Caleb Johnson: if Unknown exists but is hidden from UI, then filtering to Self-serve should probably exclude unknown, but totals might drop a lot and confuse people. We had a note to add a coverage/confidence indicator for missing dimensions.

Marissa Cole: +1 this is exactly the kind of dogfood feedback we wanted. 

Two separate issues maybe:
1) tier filter not consistently applied across components
2) confusion around what "blended" means if coverage is incomplete / if unknown is included

Rishi Malhotra: from Finance POV, for v1 the definition is blended cost allocated across *all* tokens. If tier is unknown, it should show up as Unknown tier, not silently fold into self-serve. Otherwise we can’t reconcile.

Laura Bennett: agree. also: several folks on Finance are asking "is this marginal cost?" and I keep repeating it’s blended w/ idle + shared overhead allocation per ADR. we need that stated right next to the KPI.

Aisha Bello: re: confusion — can we add a tooltip or info callout: 
- Blended $/1M output tokens = allocated infra cost / output tokens
- Not marginal, includes idle + shared overhead
- Data freshness + dimension coverage status

Would also help w/ oncall: fewer "is this wrong?" pings.

Chloe Martin: I pulled the requests from the browser. Looks like:
- KPI calls `/internal/unit_econ/timeseries?...&tier=self_serve`
- Top models calls `/internal/unit_econ/topn?group_by=model` but **tier param is missing**. :facepalm:

So yeah, table is ignoring tier filter.

Felix Schneider: yep confirmed in code. UI state is passing tier into timeseries hook but not into TopN hook.

I’ll push a quick patch + add a test that asserts filters propagate to all widgets.

Mei Lin: while we’re in there, can we decide what filtering means when tier is missing/unknown?
Options:
A) exclude unknown when tier filter is set
B) include unknown by default but show coverage
C) always show unknown as its own tier and include a checkbox

My vote: B for v1, but we need the coverage indicator so people don’t freak out.

Rishi Malhotra: A when tier is explicitly set (self-serve should mean self-serve only). But the UI should *surface* that some % is unknown so it’s clear why totals don’t match prior weeks.

Marissa Cole: +1. explicit filter should be strict.

Let’s add:
- in dropdown: keep Unknown hidden for now, but show a small "Coverage: 97%" next to Tier filter (or in the KPI header) and link to a hover explaining missing tier mapping.
- longer term: add Unknown as selectable once we’re comfy.

Caleb Johnson: I can provide a simple coverage number: `known_tier_output_tokens / total_output_tokens` per selected time range + other filters.

If it drops below threshold, we can show warning state.

Laura Bennett: also on blended vs marginal: can we add a label "Blended (allocated)" on the KPI and a toggle later for "Marginal (variable)"?

Not asking for marginal now, just want to stop people interpreting as "GPU $ per token right now".

Chloe Martin: +1000. People read "$" and assume marginal.

Felix Schneider: action items:
1) fix tier propagation to TopN endpoint + drilldown table routes
2) add inline definition text near KPI: "Blended (allocated) $/1M output tokens" + tooltip
3) add coverage indicator (tier + region probably)

I’ll file Linear + start patch.

Aisha Bello: please also include what the default behavior is for missing tier/region in tooltip: "Filtered views exclude rows with missing dimension values" (or whatever we land on). Helps w/ SRE triage.

Felix Schneider: makes sense.

(also: sorry Nora :))

Nora Ahmed: no worries, this is why we dogfood. thanks all.

:thumbsup:

Caleb Johnson: once fix lands, I’ll run a quick validation query to ensure TopN totals match KPI totals under the same filter set.

Chloe Martin: pls post PR link in here when up.

Felix Schneider: will do today.

Marissa Cole: and I’ll sync w/ Alicia (design) on where best to put the blended vs marginal explanation without cluttering the page.
